$regime.title: Tax Regime
$regime.description:
Country code that identifies the tax regime applicable to the document.
It determines which country-specific tax rules, normalizations, and validations are applied.
It may be determined automatically via normalization of a supplier or issuer tax identity
country code.

$addons.title: Addons
$addons.description:
Keys identifying the tax addons that apply special normalization, scenarios, and
validation rules to the document.

oneOf.title: Response
oneOf.description: A response to a document that has been submitted, often used in a two way communication between a customer and supplier.

oneOf.title: Update
oneOf.description: Issued by the supplier or seller that will be shared with either the customer, a fifth-corner entity such as a government agency, or both.

oneOf.title: System
oneOf.description: A system event that is not directly related to a specific document but needs to be recorded for compliance purposes.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of status being reported (e.g. "system" for internal events).

issue_date.title: Issue Date
issue_date.description: Date when the status is to be considered effective.

issue_time.title: Issue Time
issue_time.description: Time of day when the status was issued, for when extra precision is required.

series.title: Series
series.description: Optional code to group related status events together.

code.title: Code
code.description: Identifies the specific status event being reported.

ext.title: Extensions
ext.description: Additional structured data specific to the regime or addon.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.description: Entity supplying the goods or services in the original transaction.

customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Optional recipient of the original goods or services.

ordering.title: Ordering
ordering.description:
Links to related documents and additional details about which parties may be
involved in the transaction.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: Main payload of the message, describing the status of individual documents.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Notes for additional details about the event.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Unstructured data useful for internal tools.

bill.Status.description: Status represents a system or business event that needs to be recorded for compliance purposes.
